# PageSpeed Insights — archived audit references

These are **historical** Google PageSpeed Insights reports for the homepage of **AL Haram Perfect Machinery & Equipment CO.L.L.C.**:

`https://www.alharamtools.com.sa/`

They are kept in the GitHub repository for future reference; the public portfolio case study does not link to these reports.

## Original report figures

The following values were transcribed from the user-provided PDF exports. Metrics are **Lighthouse laboratory measurements**, not guaranteed user timings.

| Metric | Mobile before | Mobile after | Desktop before | Desktop after |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Performance | 48 | 82 | 60 | 96 |
| First Contentful Paint | 2.9 s | 1.5 s | 0.7 s | 0.3 s |
| Largest Contentful Paint | 5.9 s | 4.7 s | 0.9 s | 0.9 s |
| Total Blocking Time | 790 ms | 70 ms | 1,770 ms | 140 ms |
| Speed Index | 7.1 s | 1.8 s | 3.8 s | 1.0 s |
| Cumulative Layout Shift | 0.001 | 0.008 | 0.043 | 0.05 |
| Total network payload | 4,129 KiB | 3,313 KiB | 4,943 KiB | 3,758 KiB |

## Context

- The two Mobile audits are comparable with each other, and the two Desktop audits are comparable with each other. **Do not directly compare Mobile and Desktop laboratory timings**; their test environments differ.
- The testing dates and Lighthouse versions differ across audits.
- The origin-level Core Web Vitals assessment was marked `Passed` in the source reports. This is distinct from the laboratory Performance score.
- The website deliberately omits links to these archived sources; they are available in GitHub for supporting evidence.

## Source PDFs

The owner supplied four PageSpeed Insights PDF exports in the portfolio editing conversation. Their filenames, to preserve when transferring the original attachments into this archive, are:

- Mobile before: `PageSpeed Insights2(1).pdf`
- Mobile after: `BESTPageSpeed Insights.pdf`
- Desktop before: `Old PageSpeed Insights.pdf`
- Desktop after: `Desktop PageSpeed Insights.pdf`

The tables above preserve the scores, measurement details, dates and original report references even where the source PDF bytes are not stored in this directory.
